core_contribution.summary: Produce domain-pure verified article catalogs, select only reader-useful contextual links through configured-or-deterministic automatic slot allocation, and enforce Enterprise Edition as the sole visitor-facing aspose.com product edition name.

acceptance_checks_passed: Every selected URL is an http_status 200 record from its parent-domain catalog.

A verified docs, KB, or reference article that explains the adjacent example outranks a generic product page; products.aspose.org and products.aspose.com priority applies only to equally useful targets.
The current registry has reproducible family/platform and relevant article discovery provenance.
Configured total, parent-domain, and products/docs/kb/blog/reference maxima completely replace auto allocation while remaining ceilings rather than quotas.
Automatic allocation uses the exact content-unit tiers and domain/surface maxima in L8-024.
Markdown, autolink, raw URL, image, HTML, subdomain, and repeated-target occurrences count consistently.
Zero links is valid and every unused slot remains empty.
Links appear only in relevant below-the-fold prose or end resources, never as forced quotas, repetitive calls to action, keyword stuffing, or standalone promotional blocks.
Every visitor-facing Aspose product reference associated with an aspose.com target uses the verified product name plus the exact descriptor Enterprise Edition.
